openProfile: Open your GitHub profile in a new tab
linkHint: Link another provider to sign in with it too. Accounts with the same verified email link automatically.
signOutHint: Your notes stay in the cloud; this device forgets its local copy.
tokensHint: One token per agent (claude, codex, muse…). Its name shows on every timeline event the agent causes.
secretOnce: Copy this now. It is shown only once.
connectHint: wordsmith works with T3 Code, Claude Code, Codex or any agent that can make HTTP requests. Set up once, then review one pull request a day.

connectSteps.title: Create a token
connectSteps.body: Under Agent API tokens above, one per agent (claude, codex, muse…). Copy it: it's shown once.

connectSteps.title: Give it to the agent
connectSteps.body: Save it as WORDSMITH_TOKEN where the agent runs, then restart the agent app. Windows: run this in a terminal. macOS and Linux: add export WORDSMITH_TOKEN=… to ~/.zshrc or ~/.bashrc instead. In T3 Code you can also paste it into the private secret card when the agent asks.

connectSteps.title: Teach it the loop
connectSteps.body: Copy Agent setup below into your repo's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, so every session knows how to claim, report and link PRs.

connectSteps.title: Check the connection
connectSteps.body: Ask the agent to fetch the API index with your token. It should come back with your name under "you".

connectSteps.title: Put it on a schedule
connectSteps.body: In T3 Code, ask the project's thread to schedule a task every 30 minutes (or each evening) that runs the triage prompt below. Claude Code's /schedule or a cron job running any agent CLI works too.

connectSteps.title: Review one PR a day
connectSteps.body: Each run triages new features (difficulty, batch, notes), ships the small ones in that day's batch PR and leaves the big ones in "discuss". Merge the PR and its features complete themselves.

setupHint: Paste this into your agent's instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, a system prompt). It covers the whole loop.
triageHint: The prompt a scheduled run uses: rate every new feature, group the small ones into one daily PR, leave the big ones for a talk.
madeByDogs: This product was made by DOGS (opens dogs.red in a new tab)
webhookHint: In your GitHub repo or org: Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Payload URL below, content type application/json, the GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET you set in Cloudflare, events: Pull requests. Without it, wordsmith re-checks open PRs every couple of minutes while the app is open.
colorsHint: For the {theme} theme. The other shades are worked out from these four.
contrastOk: All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
sizeHint: Scales text, spacing and boxes together.
installHint: Native apps from the latest GitHub release. They sync with this account.
noRelease: No release is published yet. Installers show up here after the next one.
iosNote: iPhone and iPad can't install from GitHub. wordsmith is coming to TestFlight and the App Store; until then, open it in Safari and use Share → Add to Home Screen.
